# censable

`censable` wraps `censusapi` for common requests, with
[memoized](https://github.com/r-lib/memoise) data functions. With a
growing redistricting universe in R, it seems right to partition out
some use cases, to allow imports to be more targeted and to stop
packages from repeating each other.

## Installation

You can install the released version of censable from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r

install.packages("censable")
```

You can download the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("christopherkenny/censable")
```

## Example

``` r

library(censable)
```

The primary data functions are `build_dec` and `build_acs`

``` r

de <- build_dec(geography = 'county', state = 'DE')
```

The `build_*` functions take arguments on geography and state, at a
minimum. If you’re looking at a smaller piece of a state, you can use
`county` to subset it. Year defaults to 2010, but will be updated to
2020 around October 2021, following the API release of the 2020 Census
data.

The `build_*` functions are a convenient wrapper around `censusapi`,
with an eye towards collecting data on total population and voting age
population by race. Total population variables begin with the prefix
`pop`, while voting age population variables begin with the prefix
`vap`.

Additionally, there are memoised versions of the `build_*` functions:

``` r

de <- mem_build_dec(geography = 'county', state = 'DE')
```

These speed up repeated calls, allowing you to have code that is self
contained and reproducible, without taking the time hit of having to
re-download the data each time.

# Package index

## Build Data

Wrappers around censusapi to build redistricting data at various
geographies

- [`build_acs()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/build_acs.md)
  [`mem_build_acs()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/build_acs.md)
  : Build Data from the American Community Survey
- [`build_dec()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/build_dec.md)
  [`mem_build_dec()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/build_dec.md)
  : Build Data from the Decennial Census

## Collapse

Functions to collapse racial categories

- [`collapse4()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/collapse4.md)
  : Collapse Full Race Categories into 4 Categories
- [`collapse4_pop()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/collapse4_pop.md)
  : Collapse Population Race Categories into 4 Categories
- [`collapse4_vap()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/collapse4_vap.md)
  : Collapse Voting Age Population Race Categories into 4 Categories
- [`collapse5()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/collapse5.md)
  : Collapse Full Race Categories into 5 Categories
- [`collapse5_pop()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/collapse5_pop.md)
  : Collapse Population Race Categories into 5 Categories
- [`collapse5_vap()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/collapse5_vap.md)
  : Collapse Voting Age Population Race Categories into 5 Categories

## Recode

Functions to recode common state variables as other identifiers

- [`recode_abb_ansi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_abb_ansi.md)
  : Recode Abb by ANSI
- [`recode_abb_fips()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_abb_fips.md)
  : Recode Abb by FIPS
- [`recode_abb_name()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_abb_name.md)
  : Recode Abb by Name
- [`recode_ansi_abb()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_ansi_abb.md)
  : Recode ANSI by Abb
- [`recode_ansi_fips()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_ansi_fips.md)
  : Recode ANSI by FIPS
- [`recode_ansi_name()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_ansi_name.md)
  : Recode ANSI by Name
- [`recode_fips_abb()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_fips_abb.md)
  : Recode FIPS by Abb
- [`recode_fips_ansi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_fips_ansi.md)
  : Recode FIPS by ANSI
- [`recode_fips_name()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_fips_name.md)
  : Recode FIPS by Name
- [`recode_name_abb()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_name_abb.md)
  : Recode Name by Abb
- [`recode_name_ansi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_name_ansi.md)
  : Recode Name by ANSI
- [`recode_name_fips()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/recode_name_fips.md)
  : Recode Name by FIPS

## Join

Functions to join common state variables to other identifiers

- [`join_abb_ansi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_abb_ansi.md)
  : Join Abb by ANSI
- [`join_abb_fips()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_abb_fips.md)
  : Join Abb by FIPS
- [`join_abb_name()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_abb_name.md)
  : Join Abb by Name
- [`join_ansi_abb()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_ansi_abb.md)
  : Join ANSI by Abb
- [`join_ansi_fips()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_ansi_fips.md)
  : Join ANSI by FIPS
- [`join_ansi_name()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_ansi_name.md)
  : Join ANSI by Name
- [`join_fips_abb()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_fips_abb.md)
  : Join FIPS by Abb
- [`join_fips_ansi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_fips_ansi.md)
  : Join FIPS by ANSI
- [`join_fips_name()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_fips_name.md)
  : Join FIPS by Name
- [`join_name_abb()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_name_abb.md)
  : Join Name by Abb
- [`join_name_ansi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_name_ansi.md)
  : Join Name by ANSI
- [`join_name_fips()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/join_name_fips.md)
  : Join Name by FIPS

## GEOID Tools

Mimic or work with Census GEOIDs

- [`breakdown_geoid()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/breakdown_geoid.md)
  : Breakdown Census GEOID into Components
- [`construct_geoid()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/construct_geoid.md)
  : Create GEOID from Default Columns
- [`custom_geoid()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/custom_geoid.md)
  : Create a GEOID from Columns

## Matching Functions

Transform State Identifiers

- [`match_abb()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/match_abb.md)
  : Try to Match to State Abbreviation
- [`match_ansi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/match_ansi.md)
  : Try to Match to State ANSI
- [`match_fips()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/match_fips.md)
  : Try to Match to State FIPS
- [`match_name()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/censable/reference/match_name.md)
  : Try to Match to State Name
